title: Dhruv Rathee Interviews Former Chief Election Commissioner | Dr. S.Y. Quraishi
shows: A conversation in Hindi with S.Y. Quraishi, Chief Election Commissioner from 2010 to 2012. He says that after the revision of 2002 and 2003 the rolls were kept up to date by summary revision, with a booth level officer visiting each home and citizenship taken on the elector's own declaration in Form 6. He says almost every decision under the present Chief Election Commissioner is his alone, though the law asks for unanimity as far as possible and a majority otherwise. He argues that Form 6 cannot lawfully be used to bring back electors deleted in the revision, because it carries a declaration that the applicant has never been enrolled, and proposes a separate form approved by the Law Ministry. He also says the West Bengal election should be held again because it was held on a roll he regards as unlawful. He criticises the Supreme Court for letting that election go ahead and for sending judicial officers to do the Commission's work.
